names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 august, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Evplu, Arhidiaconul», with the rank words and the office left off.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 августа ст. ст. — «Мч. архидиакона Евпла»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 august — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Evplu, Arhidiaconul»

attestations.note: The Romanian life behind that line is this man — the deacon of Catania in Sicily under Diocletian and Maximian, taken reading the Gospel he carried, beheaded «în 11 zile ale lunii august» — so this is a row on this folder and not a second Euplus. The day page calls him «Mare Mucenic», great-martyr, where his own life page and its heading call him simply «Sfântul Mucenic Evplu diaconul»; the folder's types are left as they were. Read 24 September 2026.
Not checked: saint.gr was read for the civil week 23–29 August, which names other saints; its page for this Julian date was not read (2026-08-23).

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), календар за 24.08.2026 (11. август ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик и архиђакон Евпло“

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Евпл/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имеяй бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Того молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 11 августа ст. ст. — Тропарь мученика архидиакона Евпла

english.text: Thy martyr, O Lord (mentioned by name), through his suffering, an incorruptible crown did obtain from Thee, our God; for, rejoicing in Thy strength, he laid low his tormentors and did beat off impotent affronts of the demons also; at his intercessions save our souls.

source.text: Orloff, tr., The General Menaion (London: J. Davy & Sons, 1899), Chapter XIV, The General Service to One Martyr

hymns.text: Законы Христовы в руку обнося,/ предстал еси, вопия врагом, в подвизе:/ самозван есмь страдальчествовати твердейши./ Темже, приклонив радостно выю твою,/ подъял еси усечение мечем,// скончавый течение твое.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 11 августа ст. ст. — Кондак мученика архидиакона Евпла

english.text: Bearing the laws of Christ in thy hands, thou didst stand forth in the contest, crying out unto the enemies: Of mine own accord am I come, to suffer the more steadfastly. Wherefore, bowing thy neck with joy, thou didst endure to be cut down by the sword, and thus didst finish thy course.

hymns.text: Мученик Твој Господе, Евпло, у страдању своме је примио непропадљиви венац, од Тебе Бога нашега, јер имајући помоћ Твоју мучитеље победи, а разори и немоћну дрскост демона: Његовим молитвама спаси душе наше.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), тропар за 11. август ст. ст. — „Свети мученик и архиђакон Евпло“

english.text: Thy martyr Euplus, O Lord, in his suffering received the incorruptible crown from thee, our God; for having thy help he vanquished the torturers, and he shattered also the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Evplu, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Evplu, Arhidiaconul», Glasul 4 — the common troparion of a martyr, printed here with his name in it

english.text: Your martyr Euplus, O Lord, in his struggle received from you, our God, the crown of incorruption; for having your strength he overthrew his torturers and broke the powerless insolence of the demons. At his prayers, Christ God, save our souls.
